migration_flags.detail: The 'own' usage type does not exist in v19 community. Exactly 7 usage values: supplier, view, internal, customer, inventory, production, transit. Any migration data containing usage='own' must be remapped.
There is no scrap_location boolean field on stock.location in v19. Scrap locations are identified exclusively by usage='inventory'. Migration logic relying on a boolean flag will fail silently.
No return_location boolean field exists in v19 community stock module. Return flows are handled at picking type level, not location level.
pos_location_id is not present on stock.location in v19 community. POS location linkage is managed within the POS module separately.
valuation_account_id lives in stock_account/models/stock_location.py (the stock_account extension), not in the base stock module. It is absent if stock_account is not installed.

should_bypass_reservation() returns True only for supplier, customer, inventory, production. Transit returns False — transit locations CAN hold reserved quantities. Migration must not treat transit as virtual for reservation bypass.
write() blocks company_id changes after creation. Migration must assign company_id at create time; post-create reassignment requires archive + recreate.
Locations with usage='view' do NOT inherit parent complete_name; they reset the path to their own name. This is a boundary condition in hierarchy display and name-based matching during migration.

key_findings.scrap_pattern: usage='inventory', no boolean field, per-company via res.company._create_scrap_location()
key_findings.valued_location_condition: company_id is set AND usage in ['internal', 'transit']
key_findings.putaway_fallback: first child internal location when usage='view' and no rule matches
key_findings.complete_name_boundary: usage='view' resets complete_name to location.name only
key_findings.summary: v19 stock.location has 7 usage types; no own/scrap booleans; transit locations hold reservations; valuation in stock_account extension; view type is a complete_name boundary; company is immutable post-create
